value.rationale: The dynamics of positive integer iterates for a two-prime support are not determined by the known fixed-point theorem. This gives a uniform cycle exclusion and an explicit necessary bound tied to the prime-power exponent of a possible orbit maximum, not an arbitrary tested parameter box. The monotonicity/maximality argument shows why the bound arises and handles arbitrary outside-prime factors. The cutoff is not claimed optimal and the stronger later classification should be preferred for the unrestricted conclusion.
